text:
Elena: Heads-up—finalist (Maya B) has a conflict with the 3pm slot today. Can we reorder the run so the technical half is earlier? Also need someone to lead the debrief.

Samir Patel: I can swap to cover 2:30–3:00 if that helps. @Elena what's the new order you're thinking?

Elena: Thanks Samir. Proposed: 2:15–2:45 tech deep-dive (Samir + Jordan), 2:45–3:15 product/behavioral (Priya + Elena). Then 10m buffer and debrief at 3:25. Thoughts?

Jordan: That works for me. Can Priya confirm availability? I'll take tech Qs backlog.

Priya: I should be free but on call 3:00–3:10. If we keep the 10m buffer I'm good. Also quick ask: which rubric version are we using? I saw two copies.

Maya K: Hiring doc in drive -> https://drive.company/hiring/docs. Use the 2026-engineering-rubric v2 (finalized last week). Small change on system design scoring: bump from 4 to 5 bands.

Elena: Correct — v2. I'll paste the key anchors below:

```
System design: anchors = {pathways, tradeoffs, scalability, perf}
Execution: anchors = {clarity, test plan, edge-cases}
Culture-fit: anchors = {collaboration, feedback}
```

Focus on 'tradeoffs' for this candidate.

Samir Patel: Got it. Also, can someone own taking notes for the debrief? I'd prefer not to be the notetaker if I'm leading tech.

Jordan: I can take notes and capture action items.

people-ops-bot: Calendar updated: candidate Maya B — slot moved to 14:15-15:15 UTC-7. Room: https://meet.company/room-ops-7. Invite updated for Samir, Jordan, Priya, Elena.

Priya: Thanks. One small logistics thing: please make sure the debrief doc has scoring columns for 'confidence' + 'recommendation' (yes/maybe/no). I can fill afterwards.

hiring-bot: Reminder scheduled — debrief reminder ping at 15:20 local for attendees.

Elena: Perfect. Jordan—can you start the debrief doc from the template? Link: https://drive.company/templates/debrief-engineering-v2

If anything changes ping here, otherwise I'll assume this schedule stands.

Jordan: Starting doc now, will ping when ready.
